verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a SaaS remote-desktop service that stores session history and account data, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent features: retrieving and exporting session history, removing a client from a license or removing an alias, and uninstalling via the CLI `--remove` parameter. There is no documented retention-period setting, no deletion of session logs or account data, and no data-erasure control, so these earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
